links.label: Add a standalone cellular hotspot — GL.iNet Mudi V2

features.detail: Common GL.iNet GL-E750V2 Mudi V2 with preinstalled EM060K Cat6 modem, internal LTE antennas, own 7000mAh battery/case, nano-SIM slot and 2.4GHz Wi-Fi. Documented network architecture, not a manufacturer-tested pairing with each terminal. Exact carrier/IMEI/SIM acceptance and terminal firmware remain gates.
work_required: Add one separate Mudi V2 and activated compatible physical nano-SIM/data plan. Configure SIM/APN and a 2.4GHz WPA2 SSID in router web admin from a computer; no phone tethering, modem soldering or common battery needed.

Provision terminal SSID/password and outbound authenticated TLS bridge; implement reconnect/backoff and keep hardware credentials narrow. BM06 requires a new Wi-Fi voice client; DONOR01 weather Wi-Fi is not already a voice bridge.
Keep hotspot on its supplied power system/charger. Existing terminal battery/charger remains separate. No per-board LTE UART/USB modem engineering required.

BM07 stock initial provisioning still requires phone/app per existing evidence; computer-only terminal provisioning is a separate firmware task, so hotspot alone does not make stock first setup phone-free.
